scope: The complete game (1.0.1, harder): the PRG unpacked, the title with its menu of audio modes and PRESS FIRE, the whole dungeon (sixteen rooms in four zones, objects, doors, the portal, explorer, sword, skeletons and bats, damage, HUD), the end of a game in the room and on its end screen with score, seals and rooms, the way back to the title; the music, its pieces for the end of a game, the sound effects and silence, no note left sounding; won and lost games with the joystick only, seven games without loading again; the memory map

unpack.no_unpack: step 07: every block assembled at its address, so the PRG has holes
unpack.checks: every block equal to its generated file (the music to the assembled bytes) in the PRG and in memory at its address

title_draw_room.method: raster position (LIN*63+CYC) at every cell row of the title page; each interval shorter than a frame; includes the sound interrupt

music.method: on the title, MUSIC mode: raster position at audio_irq and irq_done; SID shadow equal to tests/player_model.py after every interrupt

hud.method: in the last game: values written by the test (keys as bits of key_set), hud_dirty set; HUD rows compared with the reference after hud_update

changes_of_room.method: raster position at every cell row of draw_room and show_door (display off); blank frames counted by the sound interrupt (irq_frames) from the start of the frame to room_shown; the start of a game clears the screen and draws the HUD first

changes_of_screen.method: draw_screen: clear_screen, the page by draw_room (timed at every cell row), big letters and words; frames counted by the sound interrupt

frame_work.method: raster position at joy_ready and at the next main_loop (the state's frame, HUD, torches); frames that draw a room or a screen are not counted; the end must come before the start of the next frame

no_stuck_notes.method: every frame, on the shadow SID registers of the C64 (the next interrupt sends them to the SID): in SILENT the volume is 0; in SOUND FX voices 2 and 3 are never gated and voice 1 is not gated when no effect plays or is asked for; in MUSIC, once a piece of the end has played its 192 frames, no voice is gated. The route crosses deaths, victories, the menu and restarts in every mode

sound.method: every frame: audio_mode, irq_frames, fx_next, fx_pos, fx_prio, music_song, music_tick, music_frames and the 25 shadow SID registers equal to tests/audio_model.py, the frame's interrupts played in the model where they came (before the requests of the frame, or while its room or screen was drawn); interrupt cost by raster position at audio_irq and irq_done

states.method: game_state, end_timer, fire_armed, stick_held and audio_mode equal to tests/game_model.py every frame; the title and end screens compared with the reference when drawn, the menu when it changes, PRESS FIRE when it appears and its glow every frame; title sprites every frame

combat.method: enemies, blow and damage timer compared with tests/combat_model.py every frame

game.note: a potion is taken only below full energy; the others are left on the floor

zones.method: colour_zone read after every change of room; the screen compared with the reference, which uses the zone's colour tables from zones.color

final_state.note: after the seventh game has begun

checks: the PRG without holes: every data block at its address after unpack, equal to its generated file
$01 = $36 before draw_room
the title's draw_room timed at every cell row, the sound interrupt running
title, end screens and rooms equal to the reference renderer (bitmap, screen RAM, Color RAM, walkability map, torch list) when drawn; the menu when it changes; PRESS FIRE when it appears

the program starts on the title with MUSIC; up and down move the cursor one line per push, stopping at both ends, up winning over down; the mode changes at once; a stick held when the title comes does not move it
Fire starts a game only when let go after a press seen on the title; on the end screen only after two seconds and with a new press
the end of a game: GAME OVER or VICTORY in the room for 50 frames, then the end screen with score, seals and rooms entered, then the title
music interrupt every frame for more than a loop on the title, SID shadow equal to the player model, cost measured
sound state and SID shadow equal to the sound model every frame in the three modes: theme, piece of the lost game, silence, every effect, priorities
no note left sounding: SILENT at volume 0, no gate in SOUND FX without an effect, none after a piece of the end, through deaths, victories and restarts
a won game and three lost games with the joystick only; seven games without loading the PRG again
explorer, room, game state (rooms entered included), combat state (35 bytes) and sprites 0-6 equal to the Python models every frame of a game
title sprites and the glow of PRESS FIRE every frame
every opening of the sixteen rooms used; entry positions as world_model.py
each room in the colours of its zone
fast skeletons, and one made slow by the test; patrols across and up and down
a blow hits an enemy on top of the explorer too
every enemy of the dungeon defeated at least once
blade in the four directions; one blow per press
enemies come back when a room is entered again
damage: two cells, then 30 frames safe, blinking
doors A, B, C and the portal as in 0.8
keys, treasures, potions and seals as the model
display off while a room or screen is drawn
all eight hero frames displayed
game work of every frame measured in every state: it ends inside the frame
flame phase of every torch every 8 frames, on every screen
bitmap unchanged outside the torch cells
HUD values rewritten by hud_update as the reference
eleven native 384x272 PAL screenshots
memory map: every area from $0801 to $CFFF, no overlap

areas.use: BASIC line, code, tables and variables
pages of the title and end screens
colour tables of the four zones
music, pieces of the end, sound effects
